name: Open Y Upgrade Tool
description: Config-upgrade helper for the Open Y / YMCA Website Services distribution (drupal.org project 'upgrade_tool', module machine name 'openy_upgrade_tool'). Tracks which config a site has customised away from the distribution defaults, shows a diff dashboard, and lets a maintainer keep the customisation or restore the distribution version.
project_description: This module adds the ability to upgrade Open Y configs and log manual config changes. It tracks changes to configuration made during manual config editing or via hook_update_N, and provides an Upgrade Dashboard that can be used to review and roll back changes that are not wanted. Part of the Open Y / YMCA Website Services distribution; the drupal.org project is named 'upgrade_tool' but the module machine name is 'openy_upgrade_tool'. Depends on the config_import module (drupal.org project 'confi') for partial-config (single-property) updates. Maintained by Ukrainian developers.
